review_evidence: README describes a Lean formal model of Semantic Versioning's BNF grammar, precedence relation and parsers. SemVer/Lemmas.lean proves transitivity properties across the identifier and Version order hierarchy.
Four of five current primary files own about 211 common declarations; SemVer/Basic.lean owns the formal syntax/parsing model and Tests.lean contains source-level examples.

Main.lean was inspected completely: it only reads two versions from stdin and prints parsed values/stability/precedence results, so it is an executable demonstration wrapper rather than formal prior art.
